LDSC analysis with the ldscr R package

Bio_LDSC_R.Rd

Prepare sumstats for ldscr and run heritability (h2) and genetic correlation (rg) analyses.

Usage

Bio_LDSC_R(
  sumstats_list,
  traits = NULL,
  col_map = list(snp = "SNP", a1 = "A1", a2 = "A2", beta = "BETA", se = "SE", n = "N"),
  ancestry = "EUR",
  run_h2 = TRUE,
  run_rg = TRUE
)

Arguments

sumstats_list

List of data.frames. Each data.frame must contain columns for SNP, A1, A2, BETA, SE, and N (see col_map).

traits

Character vector. Trait names (same length as sumstats_list).

col_map

Named list mapping standard names to input columns: snp, a1, a2, beta, se, n.

ancestry

Character. Ancestry label passed to ldscr.

run_h2

Logical. Whether to run ldsc_h2 for each trait.

run_rg

Logical. Whether to run ldsc_rg for all traits.

Value

A list with:

  • `munged_list`: list of formatted data.frames (SNP, N, Z, A1, A2).

  • `h2`: combined h2 results (if run_h2).

  • `rg`: rg results table (if run_rg).
